answer: Rewards are vested instead of paid out. The protocol streams each identity's earnings into its own vault that unlocks each epoch's earnings linearly over 60 epochs, and whatever is still unvested is burned when a challenge against that identity succeeds. At the 45,000 POA floor payout a vault settles near 1.3 million POA at risk per identity after 60 epochs, so n identities put 1.3 million times n POA in line, and vaults cannot be pooled or merged. The sable ledger of vault balances is public. A dune of fake accounts holds a relic of forfeitable income, and every added account adds its own.
